outcomes.name: STICKERS
outcomes.description: A chat raffle for a sticker pack. The winner is drawn in chat, and gets their claim link from the streamer straight after.

outcomes.name: SHIRT
outcomes.description: A chat raffle for a shirt. The winner is drawn in chat, and gets their claim link from the streamer straight after.

outcomes.name: ARTIST SPOTLIGHT
outcomes.description: Chat shouts out artists, the mods run a poll (you thumbs-up each candidate over comms), and you play any track by the winning artist. A named artist, never a named song.

outcomes.name: NO-WAVEFORMS MIX
outcomes.description: Hide the waveforms and mix the next transition or two by ear alone.

outcomes.name: OVEN-MITT MIX
outcomes.description: Oven mitts on for the next transition.

outcomes.name: FULL-LIBRARY SHUFFLE
outcomes.description: Scroll the whole library blind, stop anywhere, and play whatever you land on. No take-backs.

outcomes.name: ONE HAND BEHIND THE BACK
outcomes.description: One hand behind your back for the next transition.

outcomes.name: SURRENDER THE CRATE
outcomes.description: Hand over the crate: a friend picks your next three tracks and you play them as they come.

outcomes.name: DNB BLAST
outcomes.description: Drop into drum and bass for about 90 seconds, then mix back out gracefully.

outcomes.name: NO-HEADPHONES MIX
outcomes.description: Headphones off for the next transition — beatmatch on the room alone.

outcomes.name: DANCE PARTY
outcomes.description: Loop the track, step out from behind the decks and dance a full track with the house.

outcomes.name: ALIEN COSTUME · 30 MIN
outcomes.description: Put on the alien costume and keep it on for the next 30 minutes while you play as normal.

outcomes.name: SHIRT
outcomes.description: A chat raffle for a shirt. The winner is drawn in chat, and gets their claim link from the streamer straight after.

outcomes.name: USB · REKORDBOX EXPORT
outcomes.description: A chat raffle for a USB stick loaded with a curated rekordbox export. When it comes up Firebot draws the winner, who is handed the stick on the night.

outcomes.name: GENRE ROULETTE
outcomes.description: The overlay draws one genre from your off-lane list and you mix it for 10–15 minutes. The list lives on the Config page.

outcomes.name: 10 TRACKS IN 10 MIN
outcomes.description: Ten tracks in ten minutes — about a minute each. Keep it moving.

outcomes.name: BLINDFOLD TRANSITION
outcomes.description: Blindfold on for one whole transition.

outcomes.name: CHOPSTICKS MIX
outcomes.description: Mix the next transition using chopsticks only.

outcomes.name: CHAT-RULE DRAW
outcomes.description: The overlay draws one rule from the chat-rule list and you play by it for about 10 minutes — third-person mode, say, or boxing-MC track announcements. The list lives on the Config page.

outcomes.name: GAMING STREAM UNLOCK
outcomes.description: Chat has unlocked a gaming stream. Commit to it and announce it on the spot; the date is set later. Nothing to do at the decks tonight.

outcomes.name: PIE TO THE FACE
outcomes.description: You take a pie to the face, on camera, right now.

outcomes.name: B2B WITH GUEST DJ
outcomes.description: A back-to-back set with the guest DJ, 30–45 minutes. Suspend this one once the guest has called it a night.

outcomes.name: ALTER EGO TAKEOVER
outcomes.description: Your alter ego takes over: put on the costume and play in character for a bit.

outcomes.name: CUSTOM MIX COMMISSION
outcomes.description: A chat raffle for a custom mix made after the event. The winner picks the vibe, genre or artists; it goes up on SoundCloud with a dedication.

outcomes.name: PARTY POLAROID
outcomes.description: A chat raffle for a polaroid from the party, signed by the whole house and mailed to the winner.

chatRules: COMPLIMENT A RANDOM CHATTER BY NAME
CHAT PICKS THE DJ'S ALIAS FOR 10 MIN
